transcript: Tonight, I saw Merrily We Roll Along on Broadway starring Jonathan Groff Daniel Radcliffe and Lindsay Mendez. It was amazing, easily one of the best things I've seen all year. Merrily is one of Sondheim’s most notorious flops, its original Broadway production closed just two weeks after its opening night. This production would make that piece of history seem absolutely unbelievable but that's a testament to just how strong this revival is. The score is lovely, it's beautifully performed and so, SO well directed. The three leading actors are unreal — Jonathan's Frank is potent and emphatic, Daniel's Charlie is quirky and energized, and Lindsay's Mary is heartbreaking and earnest. And the three of them together, their humor and their chemistry is really what makes the story hit hard. Overall I'd say this production definitely lives up to the hype. It's an expensive ticket but for good reason. Run, don't walk, to see this. With that, another playbill for my collection.
